findings.message: joblib.load deserializes from a path tq cannot show is repo-relative; loading runs arbitrary code. Use safetensors or skops, torch.load(weights_only=True), or a pinned repo artifact
torch.load without weights_only=True deserializes from a download; loading runs arbitrary code. Use safetensors or skops, torch.load(weights_only=True), or a pinned repo artifact
pickle.load deserializes from a path outside the repo; loading runs arbitrary code. Use safetensors or skops, torch.load(weights_only=True), or a pinned repo artifact
